title: Compound Component Pattern with Context Sharing
problemStatement: Implement `createCompoundAccordion()` with `Accordion(items)` and `Item(id, title, content)` that coordinates which panel is open without manual prop drilling.
interviewTrap: Passing `isOpen` and `onToggle` through multiple levels of parent-child-grandchild props creates fragile code. Compound components manage shared state implicitly.

testCases.name: Opens default item on initialization
testCases.testFn: const acc = createCompoundAccordion('1'); acc.addItem('1', 'T1', 'C1'); acc.addItem('2', 'T2', 'C2'); return acc.render()[0].isOpen;

testCases.name: Switches active open panel on toggle
testCases.input: toggle('2') closes panel 1 and opens panel 2
testCases.testFn: const acc = createCompoundAccordion('1'); acc.addItem('1', 'T1', 'C1'); acc.addItem('2', 'T2', 'C2'); acc.toggle('2'); const r = acc.render(); return [r[0].isOpen, r[1].isOpen];

testCases.name: Toggling active panel closes it (accordion collapses)
testCases.input: toggle active panel collapses it to null
testCases.testFn: const acc = createCompoundAccordion('1'); acc.addItem('1', 'T1', 'C1'); acc.toggle('1'); return acc.render()[0].isOpen;

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Passing an expensive component as the `children` prop `<Parent><ExpensiveTree /></Parent>` prevents `ExpensiveTree` from re-rendering when `Parent`'s state changes! Because `ExpensiveTree` is evaluated in the grandparent's render scope, its element reference is identical across `Parent` re-renders.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Render Phase: Fiber node evaluation and hooks linked-list dispatch for Compound Components (Tabs, Accordions, Menus).
2. Reconciliation: Double buffering and fiber diffing mechanics.
3. Commit Phase: Synchronous/passive effect execution and DOM mutation.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals: In React Fiber, Compound Components (Tabs, Accordions, Menus) maintains state across work-in-progress trees and lanes scheduling priority.

complexity.time: O(1) per hook / O(N) fiber traversal
